title: OSCS 2026 - Programme
section: Hackathon:  Managing Open Projects After OSF Changes  Monday November 30th
text:
Hackathon:  Managing Open Projects After OSF Changes  Monday November 30th
On the Monday before the conference, the HOSSLab will host a hackathon titled: “Managing Open Projects After OSF Changes”. The aim of the hackathon is to prepare concise guidance for researchers. We will consider different research scenarios involving open science practices and collaboration on a smaller and larger scale. The guidance will be later available on the HOSS webpage.

Hackathon information

Time: 15:00 - 18:00
Location: Studenthuset, 6th floor, room SH62

 You can sign up for the hackathon through the conference registration link or by emailing Marta Topor at marta.topor[at]liu.se 
Sign up to the conference and hackathon

title: OSCS 2026 - Venue
text:
Getting to the conference
The conference will be hosted at the Linköping University campus, in Linköping. The venue building is called the Key House and it’s a short walk from the bus stop Nobeltorget. You can get bus no 4 from Linköping central station to Nobeltorget. The meeting will be in room KY24, which is on the ground floor, to the right-hand side after the entrance.





Travel by bus from Linköping C to LiU campus
You can check bus departures here or download the ÖstgötaTrafiken app, search for from your position to Nobeltorget (to go from the central train station, pick the bus stop Linköpings resecentrum).
 Note: If you are using the translation function on the website, the bus stops might get translated as well. In that case Linköpings resecentrum will be translated to the equivalent of “Linköping Travel Center” and Nobelberget to the equivalent of “Nobel Square”!

title: OSCS 2026 - Home
text:
Submit plenary talk abstracts!
We offer 4 spots for plenary talks. The talks will be 20 minutes each, including time for questions. Please submit your talk proposals using the link below. We will select the plenary talks in the first week of November, so your talk will be considered as long as it’s submitted by then. We will prioritize submissions that align with the theme of the conference.
